name: Coefficient Space of the Bidirected-Graph Construction
parameters: $\operatorname{AO}(H)$ is the set of acyclic orientations of $H$; for $H=K_m$ it has size $m!$.
proof: Opposite arcs make the minimal cycle arrangements exactly the edge equalities $d_v=d_w$. Each component fixes an acyclic orientation by increasing $d$; conversely every acyclic orientation defines a nonempty open convex component.
